description: The HP-15 RTO serves the Parwanoo sub-division within the Solan district of Himachal Pradesh. As a Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA), it manages the issuance of driving licenses and registration of non-transport vehicles in this major industrial border town.
address: Office of the Assistant Commissioner (AC) to Deputy Commissioner, Parwanoo, District Solan, Himachal Pradesh
